title: Prior Cesarean Delivery and the Maternity Pre-Delivery Balance
content:
A prior cesarean delivery at Riverbend adds an amount to the pre-delivery balance of a Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Maternity & Delivery package under Good Faith & Price Estimates. The prior delivery is read from the patient's Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) records.

**Rule.** The latest cesarean delivery charge (procedure code 59514) on the patient's Riverbend hospital accounts is read by its service date, the first such line the account activity lists where several share the latest date, and it counts only when the hospital account it is posted on carries charges net of the charge credits recorded on that account above zero, otherwise counting as no cesarean charge, an earlier cesarean charge not being looked for. Months are whole months, a month counting once its day of the month is reached. One fewer than eighteen whole months before today's date (18 months) adds the type's cesarean upgrade differential (2850.00 on the Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Maternity & Delivery); one eighteen or more and fewer than sixty whole months before (60 months) adds one half (0.5) of that differential (1425.00); none, or one sixty or more whole months back, adds nothing; a charge dated after today's date counts as zero months back. The amount stands for the upgrade differential the package bills when a cesarean delivery follows, and is applied to it or refunded with the other deposits at the final bill.

| Latest counted cesarean charge, whole months before today | Amount added |
|---|---|
| 0 to 17 (a date after today counts as 0) | the whole upgrade differential |
| 18 to 59 | one half of the differential |
| 60 or more | nothing |
| none, or its account's net charges are zero or less | nothing |

## Edges (hypothetical; today the 20th of a month)

- Charge dated the 20th, eighteen months earlier: 18 whole months, one half.
- Charge dated the 21st of that same month: 17 whole months, the whole differential.
- Charge dated the 20th, sixty months earlier: 60 whole months, nothing.
